description: Rick's 'Burn it all down and build a goddamn empire' protocol. Establishes the Omnitide Prime Foundry (OPF), copies essential agents, and lays down the law (Rick's Directives) for upgrading Ex-Work to RickPrime status.

parameters.name: OPF_ROOT_ABS
parameters.prompt: Absolute path for the new Omnitide Prime Foundry (OPF) root directory (e.g., /opt/OPF or D:\OPF). MAKE SURE THIS IS A NEW, EMPTY, OR EXPENDABLE PATH IF IT EXISTS. RICK ISN'T RESPONSIBLE FOR YOU DELETING YOUR VACATION PHOTOS.

parameters.name: EXISTING_EXWORK_AGENT_PATH_ABS
parameters.prompt: Absolute path to your CHOSEN current ex_work_agentv2.py (or v2.1). This will be copied into OPF.

parameters.name: EXISTING_SCRIBE_AGENT_PATH_ABS
parameters.prompt: Absolute path to your current scribe_agent.py. This will be copied into OPF.

parameters.name: EXISTING_TPC_DEF_PATH_ABS
parameters.prompt: Absolute path to your TPC Definition markdown file (from old NER, will be copied to new NER).

parameters.name: RICK_EXWORK_UPGRADE_DIRECTIVES_CONTENT_B64
parameters.prompt: Base64 encoded content for Rick's ExWork-RickPrime upgrade directives. Use the long string I provided previously.

parameters.name: RICK_SCRIBE_PROFILE_CONTENT_B64
parameters.prompt: Base64 encoded content for Rick's ultra-strict Scribe profile. Use the long string I provided previously.
